description: This Java source file defines the OpenApiConfig class, which configures OpenAPI specifications for Swagger UI documentation in a Spring Boot application. It sets up API metadata such as title, description, version, contact info, and license, relying on Springdoc's automatic server URL resolution based on application properties.

classes.name: OpenApiConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up OpenAPI (Swagger) documentation in a Spring Boot application.

methods.name: customOpenAPI
methods.description: Creates and returns a configured OpenAPI object with API metadata, including title, version, description, contact, and license information.
